anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Quoted: the head cannot say to the feet, I have no need of you.
Members of Christ; do not tear them.

pass_a_gloss: And varied is the eating of those eating the pascha, but they are all upon the same, and the one eating the head with the one chewing the feet, since the head cannot say to the feet: I have no need of you. For many members the things chewed, but one body of Christ. But as much power as there is let us keep the harmony of the members, lest we be accused as tearing the members of Christ.
pass_b_english: And [the] eating [of those who eat the Passover is] varied, [but they are all toward the same, and the one who eats the head with the one who chews the feet, since the head cannot say to the feet: I have no need of you. For the things chewed are many members, but one body of Christ. But as far as we can let us keep the harmony of the members, lest we be accused of tearing apart the members of Christ.]

Μέλη μὲν γὰρ πολλὰ τὰ τρωγόμενα, ἓν δὲ σῶμα Χ(ριστο)ῦ. Ἀλλ’ ὅση δύναμις τῶν μελῶν τὴν ἁρμονίαν τηρήσωμεν, μήπως ἐγκληθῶμεν ὡς διασπῶντες τὰ μέλη Χ(ριστο)ῦ.]
